name: camayoc_gp_paths_for_similar_work
description: golden-paths Q11: golden paths for work items like this one - v1 similarity is the deterministic core only (a shared aegis:about topic with an exemplar's work item), never model-inferred; superseded paths are excluded.
template: PREFIX aegis: <http://aegis.gastown.local/ontology/> PREFIX rdfs: <http://www.w3.org/2000/01/rdf-schema#> SELECT DISTINCT ?path ?label WHERE { <{workitem}> aegis:about ?topic . ?path a aegis:GoldenPath ; rdfs:label ?label ; aegis:prunedFrom ?exemplar . ?exemplar aegis:trajectoryOf ?exemplarWi . ?exemplarWi aegis:about ?topic . FILTER NOT EXISTS { ?path aegis:supersededBy ?w } } ORDER BY ?label
